description: This file defines a data class 'Base64ImageState' and a composable function 'rememberBase64ImageState' for managing the state of a Base64-encoded image in an Android Compose UI. It decodes a Base64 string into an ImageBitmap asynchronously and tracks decoding success or failure.
external_methods: decodeBase64Bitmap (assumed to be a helper function in the project)

classes.name: Base64ImageState
classes.description: A data class holding the decoded image (or null) and a flag indicating decoding failure.

methods.name: rememberBase64ImageState
methods.description: A composable function that manages the state of a Base64-encoded image, decoding it asynchronously and returning the current image and failure status.
